issue.title: Capacity inspector PNG snapshots are unstable before matching recapture in Full CI visual-test

task_type_fields.evidence: Proposed by sase-1q2.6 note 1 (full-ci phase of epic sase-1q2). Full CI 41174188852 at dd72e6d78a, visual-test job 124461878869, lists under 'unstable (passed on recapture)': group-1 with 4 members on capacity_inspector_120x40.png and group-3 with 1 member on capacity_inspector_busy_80x32.png. The capacity_inspector test file holds the base, busy, busy_narrow, blocked and over_limit cases. sase-1q2.6's current-master targeted visual check was clean, with 12 unchanged and 0 created or updated, so the failure is intermittent; the rate is unknown. The visual lane is advisory for release qualification. Diagnose which capture-readiness signal or uncontrolled input (clock, load feed, gauge animation) differs between the first capture and the recapture. Do not raise timeouts, relax pixels, or regenerate goldens blindly.

issue.creation_reason: sase-1q2 landing triage of sase-1q2.6's PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: the capacity-inspector drift in Full CI visual-test has no task owner and the redesign epic sase-1ox is closed.

payload.entry: Diagnostic lead from epic sase-1om landing (sase-1om.land), not a +1: phase sase-1om.9 note #1 saw this node's first capture fail once in the default xdist TZ=UTC check (2026-10-27, at the golden's creation) with a Python 3.14 _DeadlockError while importing sase.core.wait_dependency_resolution._artifact_state during the Agents tab switch; the serial recapture matched and the harness marked it unstable. Serial UTC and America/New_York reruns were clean. A concurrent-import deadlock (a worker thread importing lazily while the app thread imports the same cycle) is one concrete candidate for the 'unstable before matching recapture' signature here. Current-master targeted check of test_ace_png_snapshots_capacity_inspector.py was clean today (6 unchanged).

evidence.note: Independent current-tip reproduction while landing sase-1rq.2.1.5.1 at 291265f08a: 14-worker tools/run_pytest fast on the 18 Files/Main/stylesheet/row-patch regressions produced 17 passes and one failure in test_landed_reply_survives_same_subject_context_redelivery before the delivery assertions. Agents-tab setup stopped at agent_count=1 rather than 3; traceback is _frozen_importlib._DeadlockError on sase.core.wait_dependency_resolution._artifact_state via collect_agent_wait_status_maps. Same unchanged selection with SASE_PYTEST_WORKERS=1 passed all 18 in 27.82s. Also consolidates proposing .2 note 2 (2/~7 loaded setup failures, 6/6 serial passes) and .3 note 2 (capacity modal first-pass deadlock then matching recapture). This is the same pre-existing import-lock mechanism documented in this task, not a Main delivery failure. Retained current-tip trace attached; no timeouts changed.
